936fbaf3f6.q: How has power capacity demand in data centers evolved from kilowatts to gigawatts since the early 2010s?
936fbaf3f6.a: When Kaitlin Schaberg first joined QTS, deals were typically in the 200-250 kilowatt range. Today, deals are being done at the gigawatt level, which is a thousand times larger than megawatts. This scale shift reflects the massive growth in infrastructure needed to support new technologies like AI, with megawatt-level deals now being the minimum for companies to remain competitive.

62d5c65241.q: What infrastructure benefits do data centers provide to local communities beyond just energy consumption?
62d5c65241.a: Data centers provide community infrastructure foundations by bringing power substations and new power lines to areas that previously lacked them, which then catalyzes fiber and water utility development. This creates opportunities for retail, residential, and other development in the region. DC Blocks considers community engagement a foundational value and runs sustainability programs including tree planting, murals, and partnerships with municipalities for parks and school contributions.

5be406d640.q: Why is the data center industry becoming more attractive to younger professionals due to AI visibility?
5be406d640.a: Data centers are transitioning from an overlooked 'unsexy' industry to a mainstream topic due to AI's prominence. With AI requiring massive backend infrastructure, data centers are now recognized as the backbone of innovation. This increased visibility in mainstream news and conversations has created new college programs and internship opportunities that didn't exist before, making the industry more accessible and appealing to young professionals.

42a3024d76.q: What diverse career paths does the data center industry offer for professionals from different educational backgrounds?
42a3024d76.a: The data center industry uniquely allows professionals with backgrounds in construction management, engineering, architecture, and real estate to converge into data center roles. Unlike other industries, someone can enter from any of these disciplines and find pathways through design, construction, real estate, or operations, with exposure to customers' businesses and partner organizations throughout the delivery process.

b6d05d7d8e.q: How does AI adoption drive future power and cooling demands in global data centers?
b6d05d7d8e.a: AI workloads will operate primarily in the gigawatt power space rather than the megawatt space, requiring significant innovation in power and cooling efficiency. Schaberg notes there will be numerous new companies created around AI and existing industries will use AI to support their operations, creating a complex challenge for data centers and their partners to navigate the right efficiency path forward.
